notes: Form 1040 line 25b: 'Add the amounts shown as federal income tax withheld' on the Form(s) 1099 named in the instructions -- 1099-R box 4, and any 1099 showing withholding on dividends, taxable or tax-exempt interest, unemployment compensation, social security benefits, or other income received, box 4 (i1040gi-2025 l.2559-2576) -- and Form SSA-1099 box 6. Of the documents this engine reads, that is Forms 1099-INT, 1099-DIV, 1099-R box 4, 1099-G box 4 and SSA-1099 box 6; v1 added only the first three. Form 1099-K box 4 stays outside the class: a new source family declaring the already-published tax.us.2025.f1099k.box4-federal-withholding as a member_predicate would retroactively require member-transition for every existing plain-assertion use of that fact (SC-R1), and one family may authorize only one subtotal (ADR-0016); a nonzero 1099-K box 4 is refused by the 1099-K loss-reason rule, never left out silently. Each document's own subtotal rule is pinned and added here, one addend per document, so the explanation walk reaches each one. The 1099-G and SSA-1099 subtotals exist only from core v59 (ADR-0082: earlier packages refuse the amounts this rule would otherwise omit).
